g.text: Both panels show relative change (%) from May 2022 = 0 · Ages 15+ · Dashed line marks 2023
Employment change = 100 × (Eₜ / E₂₀₂₂ − 1). Unemployment rate change = 100 × (uₜ / u₂₀₂₂ − 1).
Underlying u = 100 × unemployed / (employed + unemployed), including first-time jobseekers. Relative changes are not percentage-point changes.
